metadata.description: fabrik: a knowledge base for a single person, kept in their own Supabase project.

plugins.name: fabrik
plugins.description: Lets a person work in their own fabrik knowledge base, in their own Supabase project: records, files and their search, boards, graphs and printed PDFs.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Publishes files from your computer to Cloudflare Pages and sets DNS records, from a folder you name, with no token creation.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Writing rules and checks so what you send reads as a person wrote it, not a machine.

plugins.name: animator
plugins.description: Turns a recipe request into an animated, narrated recipe video you can cook along to, with a printable recipe card. It's the plugin behind animated.recipes.

plugins.name: trip-agent
plugins.description: A trip planner that works like a travel agent across the desk. It learns your taste from pairs of hotel photos, then suggests countries, hotels and flights one at a time. It's the plugin behind tripagent.me.
